title: Conveyancing Paralegal
description:
Paralegal - Residential Conveyancing
- Annual Salary: £26,000 - £32,000
- Location: Farnham, UK
- Job Type: Full-time

Join a dynamic and growing Residential Conveyancing team in Farnham as a full-time Paralegal. This role offers the chance to work closely with experienced lawyers, supporting a diverse caseload across various matters. It's an excellent opportunity for career growth, offering a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support experienced lawyers by managing a caseload of Residential Conveyancing matters.
- Perform a full range of administrative duties including managing calls, responding to enquiries, and providing updates to clients, estate agents, lenders, and solicitors.
- Handle file opening procedures ensuring compliance, draft contract packs, and manage post-exchange administration including preparing COTS, conducting final searches, lodging SDLT, and AP1.
- Deal with Land Registry requisitions and occasionally perform dictation tasks.
- Maintain high standards of client care, ensuring effective communication and updates.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a Paralegal in the legal sector, preferably within Residential Conveyancing.
- Familiarity with Conveyancing processes and procedures.
- Experience with Tikit Partner for Windows is advantageous.
- Excellent client care skills with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to multitask, set priorities, and manage time effectively.
- Proficiency in modern IT systems, both audio and copy typing, and diary management.
- Attention to detail and a strong commitment to confidentiality.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary.
- 25 days annual leave plus Bank Holidays.
- Offices closed between Christmas and New Year with paid leave in addition to annual leave.
- Hybrid working options.
- Salary sacrifice pension scheme with a matching 5% contribution.
- Life assurance and Group Income Protection scheme.
- BUPA cashback plan and Private Medical Insurance.
- Enhanced Family Friendly policies.
- Employee Assistance Programmes including a GP Consultation service.
- Funded professional subscription fees and support towards professional qualifications.
- Employee Referral Scheme and Volunteering programme.
- Car Parking Season Ticket Loan.
- A range of social events including a summer and Christmas party.

To apply for this Paralegal position in Residential Conveyancing, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role to Mark Watts at Reed, your "very friendly" local legal recruitment specialist!

title: Legal Secretary
description:
Private Client Legal Secretary
- Location: Farnham
- Salary: £27,000 - £30,000 (DOE)
- Job Type: Full-time, Office based

We are seeking an experienced Legal Secretary to enhance our Private Client team in Farnham. This role involves providing comprehensive secretarial support, ensuring efficient handling of a diverse caseload, and contributing to the overall client service excellence.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Provide secretarial support to the Private Client team, managing a variety of legal matters efficiently.
- Prepare legal documents, manage correspondence, and maintain files to ensure they are up-to-date.
- Utilize modern IT systems for audio and copy typing, and manage electronic diaries effectively.
- Assist in the administration of estates, drafting of wills, and preparation of other legal documents under attorney supervision.
- Ensure confidentiality and security of all practice and client documentation and information.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a Legal Secretary, preferably within the Private Client sector. Candidates from other legal backgrounds who demonstrate transferable skills are also encouraged to apply.
- Excellent client care skills, with a commitment to providing high-quality service.
- Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in modern IT systems and software, including Tikit (PW4 or Partner for Windows).
- Effective communication and teamwork skills, capable of working collaboratively in a busy environment.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with office closure between Christmas and New Year.
- Hybrid working options, subject to role requirements.
- Employer-matched pension scheme and life assurance.
- Private medical insurance and BUPA cashback plan.
- Funded professional subscriptions and support towards professional qualifications.
- Employee referral and volunteering programs.
- Social events including summer and Christmas parties.

To apply for the Private Client Legal Secretary position, please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in this role to Mark Watts, at Reed - your local Legal Recruitment specialist.
